system.description: You have been granted the favor of confession with one of the ranking priests among the Lasombra, giving you a discreet line to one of the clan's powers-that-be and a measure of prestige among your peers — it was you who was summoned, after all. Given time and the right Backgrounds, you may become such a confessor yourself, gaining access to whatever secrets are whispered in the confessional, subject always to its sanctity.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book One: Magisters
